searchText: Thank you! Does the randao still use VDF calculations btw? Here is the detailed description of RANDAO implementation in the beacon chain https://github.com/ethereum/annotated-spec/blob/master/phase0/beacon-chain.md#aside-randao-seeds-and-committee-generation. VDF is still in the research stage hence is not in production yet oh cool! Thank you. I didn't find that! hmm how does the beacon chain select the validators randomly atm then? ah, I see. Its explained there seems like the current system is VRF as the randomness is derived from signatures. even thought its not name dropped in the specs Pretty sure RANDAO is not a VRF there's quite many specs for "RANDAO", but the one described in the phase0 specs seem like one with VRF you commit to a random number and then you reveal it, and when you reveal it, everyone need to be able to verify that you didn't lie about that. Also nobody can know what it is that you committed into before you reveal it Right, randomness outputs in the beacon chain is a product of VRF, the design is inspired by RANDAO but deviates from original RANDAO design yeah, I think original RANDAO uses VDF's I don't think it's based on the VDF, https://github.com/randao/randao ah, you are right. I got confused by this proposal tha combines RANDAO with VDF: https://ethresear.ch/t/minimal-vdf-randomness-beacon/3566
